params.description: The unique identifier of the recommendation pod containing the product set.

params.name: key
params.description: The key of the index to use.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: Email campaign identifier for tracking and analytics.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Seed item ID used for item-based recommendations (e.g., complementary).

params.name: filters
params.description: Any number of filtering criteria used to narrow the result set, such as `color=blue` or `group_id=sandals` or `price=100-200`. Facets, item groups and collection IDs can be used as filters. If `filter_value` has the form `<min>-<max>`, it is interpreted as a range. Filters with the same key are ORed together and filters with different keys are ANDed together by default. Only results that match the filters are returned. Boolean values are serialized with the first letter capitalized (e.g., `True` / `False`) as a convention.

params.name: filter_name
params.description: **DEPRECATED. Please, use 'filters' instead**. Name of the product attribute to filter by (e.g., brand, category, color). Must be provided together with `filter_value`.

params.name: filter_value
params.description: **DEPRECATED. Please, use 'filters' instead**. Value to filter the specified attribute by. Must be provided together with `filter_name`.

params.name: num_results
params.description: The maximum number of recommended items to retrieve.

params.name: c
params.description: The ID of the client and version that the request is coming from, such as `cio-js-2.90`.

params.name: us
params.description: User segment is a client context value (such as platform, location, etc.) that is used to evaluate redirect or refined tag rules. You can supply multiple segments by passing multiple `us` arguments.

params.name: ui
params.description: Unique identifier for the user to personalize recommendation results.

params.name: base_url
params.description: Base URL used to construct the product detail page redirect URL (e.g., 'https://example.com').
